packageRules.description: Majors wait for a human: each one is a network audit (docs/standards.md, rule 2).
Dev tooling, minor and patch, as one PR.

allowScripts in package.json is version-pinned: the new version must be re-approved with `npm install-scripts approve` in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ This package runs an install script. Review it, then run `npm install-scripts approve {{{depName}}}` and commit the updated `allowScripts` pin before merging.
